valuation.method: Forward Non-GAAP Diluted EPS x P/E (FY2027E EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Slower EDA/IP renewal and AI hardware capex moderation

base.driver: Continued 17% Non-GAAP EPS growth backed by $8.2B backlog and Core EDA/IP demand

bull.driver: Accelerated agentic AI design tool adoption and IP/System Design & Analysis outperformance

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E Non-GAAP EPS of $9.85, the $323.01 close implies 32.8x; the ~$415 consensus analyst target implies 42.1x or $11.53 EPS at 36.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.85 (3.0 pp of upside at the $323.01 close)
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly Non-GAAP operating margin, Core EDA/IP revenue growth, and $8.2B backlog conversion
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 earnings release (expected late February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 26, 2026, Needham ($430), Baird ($440), JPMorgan ($420), and Rosenblatt ($425) all raised their price targets while reiterating Buy/Outperform/Overweight ratings. Street targets cluster around $410-$415, implying ~28.5% upside versus our +9.8% base-case upside (+18.7 pp gap), reflecting a higher assumed forward P/E (~42.1x vs. 36.0x) or stronger FY2027E EPS. Coverage in this sample is concentrated in Buy-equivalent ratings, and Goldman Sachs's $470 target predates Q3 earnings.
